# DATAPULSE SOCIAL

> Social growth and course design for experts. We build the system that attracts an audience, nurtures it, and converts it into paid courses.

## About

DATAPULSE SOCIAL helps experts grow online and turn their knowledge into paid courses. We combine social growth strategy with course design so the audience you attract has a clear next step.

## Services

- **Social Growth** — positioning and audience clarity, content strategy and production, conversion-focused optimization
- **Course Build** — curriculum and learning journey design, lessons, scripts and course assets, assessments, and launch support

## Pricing

- Social Management — custom scope
- Course Build — custom scope
- Membership — $49/month (monthly content calendar, prompts and templates, strategy training)
- Custom / Hybrid — custom scope

Strategy calls can be booked from the website.
